title: Comprehensive multi-omics analysis identifies chromatin regulator-related signatures and TFF1 as a therapeutic target in lung adenocarcinoma through a 429-combination machine learning approach
summary: A 429-combination learned prognostic signature stratified lung-adenocarcinoma survival; TFF1 knockdown also reduced tumor growth in experimental models. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
organization: Department of Thoracic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, China
